text: {"lessons":["I sold winners to lock in gains, then bought some back at higher prices; I should base sales and purchases on my plan, not the satisfaction or pain of realizing a result.","A falling account value is uncomfortable, but it does not make past prices predictive; I should avoid reactive trading and judge risk against my long-term goals.","I should review diversification and position sizes across the whole portfolio, making deliberate changes only when they fit my risk plan rather than simply holding or trading by habit."]}
